text: Rishikesh lies in the Himalayan foothills along the Ganga and is known for yoga, spiritual traditions, ashrams and outdoor activities.
The Rishikesh guide lists Ram Jhula, Triveni Ghat, Beatles Ashram, Bharat Mandir and Gita Bhawan among local attractions.
Incredible India lists Jolly Grant Airport near Dehradun and Rishikesh Railway Station among travel links for Rishikesh.
Incredible India recommends September to November and February to April for spiritual exploration and outdoor activities in Rishikesh.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
